info.title: Tock
info.description: Delivered files, declared shapes, and counts that name the run that produced them.

post.summary: Count a mapped run and freeze it

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A token of your choosing identifying this request. Send the SAME token when retrying and the original response is replayed instead of the work being done again; the reply carries `Idempotency-Replayed: true` when it was. Reusing a token for a different request is refused with 409. Remembered for 24 hours.

post.description: Counts a mapped run and freezes it. Which run is current is derived, never stamped.

post.summary: Declare a named stream of files

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A token of your choosing identifying this request. Send the SAME token when retrying and the original response is replayed instead of the work being done again; the reply carries `Idempotency-Replayed: true` when it was. Reusing a token for a different request is refused with 409. Remembered for 24 hours.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, capped at 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's `nextCursor`. Keyset over `created_at` — exclusive, so no row is repeated. Follow the `Link` header rather than assembling this yourself: a cursor is only valid for the sort that issued it.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Walk direction.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Which declared column to walk.

200.description: One page of results. The walk is in the response headers.

Link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page, e.g. `<https://…/customers?limit=20&cursor=01J8Z…>; rel="next"`. Follow it verbatim — it carries this request's filters and page size. Absent when the walk is over, so a client stops rather than fetching an empty page.

ValidationFailed.description: Validation failed — the input did not parse against the operation schema. Carries `code`: `validation_failed`.

Unauthenticated.description: No session — sign in (or present a bearer token) first. Carries `code`: `unauthenticated`.

Forbidden.description: Refused — the caller lacks the permission this operation checks, or policy forbids it. Carries `code`: `permission_denied` or `forbidden`.

NotFound.description: Unknown operation, or an entity named in the input does not exist. Carries `code`: `not_found`.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with current state — an illegal transition, a name already taken, or a record that is immutable now. Carries `code`: `conflict`.

InternalError.description: Internal error. The body carries no `detail`, deliberately — an unreviewed message is not disclosed on a multi-tenant surface. Carries `code`: `internal`.

Unavailable.description: The deployment cannot serve this — a required platform facility is unconfigured. Carries `code`: `unavailable`.

session.name: sb_session
session.description: The vertical's session cookie. Instances on the Better-Auth provider use its cookie instead; same-origin requests carry either automatically.
